merge_cfg_from_file: merge a yaml config file into the global Detectron cfg object to override default options
merge_cfg_from_list: merge a list of key value pairs from the command line into the global Detectron cfg
assert_and_infer_cfg: assert and infer derived config values then optionally make the global cfg immutable
get_output_dir: get the output directory path for training or testing based on datasets and model type
load_cfg: load and parse a yaml config file with backward compatibility for renamed modules
